issues.issue: The serious risks listed (hypersensitivity reactions, hyperglycemia, interstitial lung disease, bowel perforation, acute renal failure) are not supported by any citation quote.

False-positive flag: '3' refers to 'phase 3', which is supported by the pivotal trial citations.
